meta.scope: UAE Batch 5 — Labour force, education, health, and policy interest-rate series under the locked data specification. Evidence-grade dependencies only.

reports.title: Labour Force statistics (employed population and labour force by citizenship, gender, age, activity)
reports.description: Official labour-force and employment statistics broken down by citizenship, gender, age group, economic activity and employment status. Captures the large non-national component of the workforce.

reports.title: Education statistics (general and higher education)
reports.description: Official statistics on general education and higher education enrolment and related indicators.

reports.title: CBUAE Base Rate decisions (Overnight Deposit Facility)
reports.description: Policy interest-rate decisions for the Base Rate applicable to the Overnight Deposit Facility. The rate is anchored to the US Federal Reserve’s Interest Rate on Reserve Balances and signals the monetary-policy stance under the dirham peg.

_dropped.edge: ae-base-rate -> ae-monetary-statistics (policy rate appears in monetary bulletin)
_dropped.why: The Base Rate is the policy signal and the Monthly Statistical Bulletin reports monetary aggregates and rates, but no specific CBUAE document located in this pass states an explicit methodological or data dependency with a quotable sentence linking the two series as defined nodes.
Labour input is conceptually linked to national accounts, but no FCSC methodological note was retrieved that asserts a concrete data dependency with a direct quote.
Enrolment and health-service statistics are typically denominated by population, but no explicit FCSC statement of dependency was located in this pass.

Emiratisation is a high-centrality policy frame that repeatedly cites labour-force statistics by citizenship. No single recurring official statistical product solely dedicated to Emiratisation rates was isolated in this pass; deferred.

_dropped.edge: oil / gas production volumes -> energy-royalties or national-accounts
_dropped.why: Hydrocarbon volumes remain central. energy-royalties is the closest domain tag but does not cleanly cover production or export volumes. Deferred pending domain clarification or a dedicated series with clear domain fit.
